summary: Patch correctly gives String Atom argument invariance via minimal, self-contained changes; the func-as-lambda approach is an acknowledged interim hack but is safe here since String's args tuple is always empty.

issues.description: func is overridden as a lambda ignoring passed args instead of a proper classmethod/property reconstructing from args; harmless only because String/QuotedString always have empty args, and the author's own comment flags it as temporary pending a general Atom.func fix.
Unrelated removal of a blank line after kwargs() in Token is stray scope creep, though trivial.
